items.quote: Chef Randy was AMAZING! He cooked a private dinner for 2 and he was prompt and most importantly professional. He came in with all his own things and went straight to work. The food was well seasoned and huge portions!
Best personal Chef Hands down!! Fed all my brothers for a bachelor party. Was punctual and fast, also cleaned up after his work. Will always book him.
Phenomenal chef!! He has done several amazing meals for the wife and I at home on special occasions! Amazing food, lamb chops shrimp lobster everything was amazing.
